# Inline formatting

**bold** and __bold__, *em* and _em_, ***both***, `code`, ``code with ` tick``.

Intra*word*emphasis and snake_case_word stay as typed.

Line one
line two after a soft break.

Line with two trailing spaces  
hard break, and a backslash\
hard break.

Escapes: \*not em\*, \# not a heading, 1\. not a list, \\ backslash, \`not code\`.

Entities: &copy; &amp; &lt;tag&gt; &#x1F600; &#169; non&nbsp;breaking.

"Straight quotes", 'apostrophes', -- two dashes, --- three dashes, ... dots stay as typed.
